name: Separate Communication Stream with 1F1B Pipelining
aliases: 1F1B Pipelining for Parameter Loading and Gradient Offloading
CUDA Stream Pipelining for Gaussian Splatting Training
definition: A pipelined execution strategy using two CUDA streams (computation and communication) to interleave parameter loading and gradient offloading, analogous to 1F1B (1 Forward, 1 Backward) pipelining.
